required_followup: Verify/remove the obsolete build-runner RPATH during packaging.
Preserve data files and add upstream licensing/corresponding-source compliance material.
Re-sign final Mach-O code and verify the complete app on target macOS.

packaging_findings: Preserve complete installed wheel layouts including .dist-info, spaCy model metadata, Misaki dictionaries and native shared libraries.
Exact Misaki 0.9.4 invokes spacy.util.is_package before spacy.load; folder-only model copies can cause a download attempt.
Exact Misaki 0.9.4 has no additional neural G2P fallback. Current GitHub main differs from the published wheel.
Use bundle-relative absolute paths derived at runtime, not developer home paths, Homebrew prefixes, external Bionic folders or a copied virtual environment.
Run the existing CPU TTS helper as a private bundled child process; stdio IPC does not require a server.
Keep local-only model loading and download prevention. Missing assets must fail closed with a local actionable error.
Native whisper.cpp with AVFoundation capture/resampling avoids OS speech-model provisioning. It still needs microphone permission.
A source-built minimal whisper.cpp variant can disable CoreML, Metal and OpenMP and use system Accelerate. Build/inference equivalence is unverified.

release_gates: Complete a reproducible recursively pinned and hashed ARM64 wheel/runtime/model lock; fill all null artifact/hash/license fields.
Audit every shipped Mach-O architecture, minimum OS, load dependency and RPATH; no unresolved external non-system library paths.
Verify source correspondence and license obligations, especially eSpeak/phonemizer/num2words and bundled native libraries.
Build/sign/notarize the app and nested code; relocation and signature verification are required after any Mach-O changes.
Cold-start from a relocated app on clean supported M3+ macOS 26.4 or later with networking disabled, no external Python/Bionic/Homebrew and empty model caches.
Demonstrate bf_isabella CPU synthesis and microphone STT without Apple speech assets, including first-run, cancellation, repeated requests and relaunch.
Measure latency, peak memory and final installed/download size on target hardware. None is established by publisher archive sizes.
hash_semantics: All hashes are SHA-256. Publisher metadata hashes are expected hashes only, not proof the final app contains those bytes. Only records marked downloaded_bytes_sha256_verified were independently hashed in this research. Runtime/model binaries were not executed.
